question: who founded the Ramakrishna Mission in 1897?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swami Vivekanand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swami Vivekananda **was a disciple of **Ramakrishna Paramahansa, **a prominent figure in the Bengali Renaissance and a mystic saint.
 
• Swami Vivekananda founded the Ramakrishna Mission as a spiritual and philanthropic organization in memory of his guru Ramakrishna Paramahansa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ramakrishna Paramahansa was a mystic saint and spiritual teacher who had a profound influence on Swami Vivekananda. He did not find the Ramakrishna Mission himself.
 
• Keshav Chandra Sen was a social reformer and religious leader who founded the Brahmo Samaj, a socio-religious movement in Bengal. He did not have any direct connection with the Ramakrishna Mission.
 
• Debendranath Tagore was a philosopher and social reformer who founded the Brahmo Samaj along with Keshav Chandra Sen. He also did not have any direct connection with the Ramakrishna Mission.
